file_id: Nurul Hassan (Ripon) vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 2 December, 2025

sentences.text:
Nurul Hassan (Ripon) vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 2
December, 2025
02.12.2025
Court No.42
Item No.7
Sudipta
 Crr 1120 of 2025
 Nurul Hassan (Ripon)
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Jayanta Narayan Chatterjee, Sr. Adv.
 Ms. Moumita Pandit
 Ms. Ritushree Banerjee
 Mr. Suprovo Dey
 Ms. Olivia Dutta
 ...for the petitioner.

1. 
Present petition has been filed for quashing of proceedings in connection with Gr Case no.622 of
2024 arising out of Lalgola Police Station Case No. 124 of 2024 dated 21st February, 2024 under
Sections 498A / 307 of the Ipc.
2.

Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is a police constable and he
has filed the documents on record to show that on the alleged date of incident he was on duty.
Learned Senior Counsel further submits that false and frivolous complaint has been lodged against the petitioner.
3. Issue notice to the State of West Bengal through the office of the Public Prosecutor.
Opposite party no.2 be also served.

5. Let the matter appear in the Combined Monthly List of January, 2026.
6.
In the meanwhile, English translated copy of documents in vernacular language be filed along with a supplementary affidavit.

(Dinesh Kumar Sharma, J.)
